999008199.text:
しっかし、久しぶりに会えると思ったら
もう雷鳴の島だっけ？　出発してたとは……

localizations.en: And here I thought I'd finally get to see her after all this time—only to find out she'd already left for the Thundering Isle...

999008199.text: もうちょっと早く来てたらよかったなぁ～

localizations.en: I should've gotten here a little sooner.

999008199.text:
私も雷鳴の島についていきたかった。
あいつらへの借りは、私自らの手で返したいもの

localizations.en: I wanted to go with them too. I want to settle the score with those two myself.

999008199.text:
兄としては、妹が危険にさらされるのは嫌だから
単身突入される前に合流できてよかったけどね

localizations.en: As her brother, the last thing I want is for my little sister charging in alone. I'm just glad we reached her before it came to that.

999008199.text: リヒャルト兄さん……
クレオ……

私も子どもの頃、冒険に兄さんを連れてった時
守ってあげなきゃって思ったよ

localizations.en: You know, when we were kids and I dragged you into the woods on adventures, I always felt like I had to protect you.

999008199.text: ああ、子ども二人で森の奥は怖かったとも！

localizations.en: Yes, well—two children alone deep in the forest was absolutely terrifying, for the record!

999008199.text: 妹さんの尻に敷かれてるの？

localizations.en: Does she have you wrapped around her little finger?

999008199.text:
まあ……自慢じゃないが、剣の腕じゃ
まったくかなわないからね

localizations.en: Well... I'm not proud of it, but she has me completely outmatched with a sword.

999008199.text: そうね！

即答するなぁ。
事実とはいえ、もうちょっと兄の威厳を……

localizations.en: You didn't have to agree so fast. It's true, but a man needs some dignity...

999008199.text:
でもまあ、いつもは心配する側だから
心配される側になるってのは久しぶりだし

localizations.en: Though honestly, I'm usually the one doing the worrying. It's been a while since someone worried about me for a change.

999008199.text: ……ありがと？
どういたしまして
麗しき家族愛……姉様、私たちも負けてられない

localizations.en: Such beautiful sibling love... We can't fall behind, Alvina.

999008199.text:
今調合いいとこだから、ちょっと待ってて。
後でたっぷりね

localizations.en: I'm at a tricky part of the synthesis right now—give me just a minute. I'll make it up to you later.

999008199.text: どっぷりね
みんな仲良しが一番ね

localizations.en: There's nothing better than everyone getting along.

999008199.text:
うん……これからも一緒に頑張らないと。
レスナたちが九偉人を倒しても、まだ敵は残ってる

localizations.en: Yeah... We have to keep pushing forward together. Even if Resna and the others defeat the Nine, the threat isn't gone.

999008199.text:
パルメ族の親玉、アウグストとザスキア……
きっと、戦うことになるから

localizations.en: The Palme's leaders—August and Saskia... We'll almost certainly have to face them too.

999008199.text: ……えっ？　なんでここでザスキアが？

localizations.en: ...Wait. Why is Saskia's name coming up here?

999008199.text:
あそっか、メーヴェさんは知らないっすよね。
ザスキアさんは、世界を管理するパルメ族の一人で――

localizations.en: Oh right, you wouldn't know. Saskia is one of the Palme—beings who manage the world from behind the scenes—

999008199.text:
……あのザスキアが、そんな！？
どこか浮世離れしている感じはあったけど……

localizations.en: ...Saskia? That Saskia?! She always seemed a little... otherworldly, but...

999008199.text:
ヘルトとゼロの上官みたいなものなんだよね？
それなら、部下の責任を取ってもらわないと！

localizations.en: She's basically Held and Zero's superior, right? Then she needs to answer for what her subordinates have done!

999008199.text:
今回は留守番でも、次はきっと大活躍。
戦力が増えるの、大歓迎

localizations.en: I had to sit this one out, but next time, I'll more than make up for it. More allies is always welcome.

999008199.text:
うーん、何かの間違いだと思うけど……
まぁ、直接聞くしかないわね

localizations.en: There must be some mistake... Either way, I'll just have to ask her directly.

999008199.text:
よし、あとは仕上げ！
もっかい釜をかき混ぜるだけ！

localizations.en: Alright—time for the finishing touch! Just need to stir the cauldron one more time!

999008199.text:
ねね、その仕上げって、私みたいな素人でも
できちゃったりする？

localizations.en: Hey, hey—could even someone like me help with that? Someone who knows nothing about alchemy?

999008199.text:
え？　ええ、この工程は特に錬金術の素養とか、
必要ないっすけど……

localizations.en: Hm? Well... this part doesn't really require any alchemy knowledge, so...

999008199.text:
娘のする錬金術というものを、私もやってみたくて。
クレオちゃんもやりたそうにしてたよね？

localizations.en: I want to try doing what my daughter does. Creo looked like she wanted to give it a go too, didn't she?

999008199.text:
もちろん、知らないことへの興味は津々、
リヒャルト兄さん譲りの好奇心だよ！

localizations.en: Absolutely! Curiosity is my middle name—must be the Richard in me!

999008199.text:
はは……でも、そうっすね。今調合してるものは
アタシの新境地を拓くためのもの――

localizations.en: Ha... I suppose that's fair. What I'm synthesizing right now is meant to break through my own limits—

999008199.text:
今のアタシがあるのはみんながいてくれたから。
縁ってことで手伝ってもらいたいな

localizations.en: And everything I've become is because of the people around me. So it only feels right to have you all help bring it to life.

999008199.text:
もちろん、ベップもヤンネさんにも。
ロマンさんも、いいかな？

localizations.en: That means you too, Bepp. And you, Janne. Roman—would you mind joining in as well?

999008199.text:
大役を仰せつかってしまったな。
もちろん、私でよければ力を貸すよ

localizations.en: What an honor. Of course—if I can be of any help, I'm happy to lend a hand.

999008199.text:
よーし、いくわよ、クレオちゃん！
初めての共同作業よ！

localizations.en: Alright then, let's do this, Creo! Our first joint operation!

999008199.text:
とろみがついてて結構重い……！
これは鍛錬になるかも！！

localizations.en: It's thick—this is actually heavy...! This might count as training!!

999008199.text:
（ほんと、みんながついていてくれる。
　そう思えたら、一歩、踏み出せるはず）

localizations.en: (Everyone's here with me. When I let myself feel that... maybe I really can take that next step.)
